description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class 'CorsConfig' that sets up global CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) policies for a web application. It creates a CorsFilter bean configuring allowed origins, methods, headers, and cache duration to enable cross-origin requests, including support for Swagger UI and preview environments.

classes.name: CorsConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that provides a global CORS filter for the application, allowing cross-origin requests with flexible origin patterns.

methods.name: corsFilter
methods.description: Defines a Spring Bean that provides a CorsFilter with specific CORS policies such as allowed origins, HTTP methods, headers, and cache duration.
